G2.description: Every factual sentence carries at least one citation.

G3.description: Every citation id exists in the ledger and in the source list; no uncited source.

G4.description: Every number, date, percentage and money amount in a sentence is supported.

G5.description: Sentences citing a contested cluster sit in the conflicting section or are hedged.

G6.description: Single-source findings are labelled as such.

G7.description: Exhausted sub-questions are listed under known gaps.

G8.description: Source URLs are valid http(s), canonical and unique.

G9.description: No sensitive identifier or secret pattern in the output.

G10.description: Report language matches the question language.

G11.description: Every recommendation links to at least one finding.

G12.description: Cited findings have validated evidence and confirmed temporal applicability.
